stretch.task: Extend the program to show 'Warning' at exactly two failed attempts and 'Locked' at three or more.
stretch.hint: Check higher threshold first, then the lower one.
stretch.answer: IF attempts >= 3 -> Locked; ELSE IF attempts == 2 -> Warning; else Try again.

mastery.task: Adapt the program to reset the failure counter after a successful login, but not disclose the password. Give test cases for a wrong attempt followed by a success.
mastery.hint: Maintain attempts separately from a Boolean success flag.
mastery.answer: On success: attempts=0 and print a generic success message. On failure: increment attempts, lock at >=3. Test 2 failures+success -> reset; 3 failures -> locked; never print a secret.

ido.question: Identify and correct the login errors. Stop after three attempts. Assume a test password is supplied.
ido.scaffold:
// Faulty example
guess = input("Password?")
while guess != password
    print(password)
    guess = input("Try again:")
endwhile
print("Welcome")

steps.title: Identify the faults
steps.explanation: A user can guess forever, and an incorrect guess reveals the secret.
steps.code:
// Faulty example
guess = input("Password?")
while guess != password
    print(password)
    guess = input("Try again:")
endwhile
print("Welcome")

steps.title: Protect the password
steps.explanation: Never reveal the secret in an error message: another person could use it to log in.
steps.code:
// Faulty example
guess = input("Password?")
while guess != password
    // Do not reveal the password
    guess = input("Try again:")
endwhile
print("Welcome")

steps.title: Initialise the state
steps.explanation: Start at zero so the limit is accurate. No password has been verified yet.

steps.title: Restrict the loop
steps.explanation: Use AND so guessing stops when either the limit is reached or the password is correct.
steps.code:
attempts = 0
authenticated = false
while attempts < 3 AND authenticated == false

steps.title: Check and count a guess
steps.explanation: Update the login result and counter on every pass, or the loop may never stop.
steps.code:
attempts = 0
authenticated = false
while attempts < 3 AND authenticated == false
    guess = input("Password?")
    authenticated = guess == password
    attempts = attempts + 1
endwhile

steps.title: Decide the outcome
steps.explanation: Check success after the loop: a third correct guess must still be accepted.
steps.code:
attempts = 0
authenticated = false
while attempts < 3 AND authenticated == false
    guess = input("Password?")
    authenticated = guess == password
    attempts = attempts + 1
endwhile
if authenticated == true then
    print("Welcome")
else
    print("Locked")
endif

steps.title: Test the stopping rules
steps.explanation: Three wrong guesses lock the login; a correct second guess ends it immediately.
steps.code:
attempts = 0
authenticated = false
while attempts < 3 AND authenticated == false
    guess = input("Password?")
    authenticated = guess == password
    attempts = attempts + 1
endwhile
if authenticated == true then
    print("Welcome")
else
    print("Locked")
endif
